record.text_en: [x]Deathrattle: Deal this minion's Attack damage randomly split among all enemies.

record.name: 强能箭猪
record.text: 亡语： 造成等同于本随从攻击力的伤害，随机分配到所有敌人身上。
record.text_en: [x]Deathrattle: Deal this minion's Attack damage randomly split among all enemies.

face.name: 膨水鳐
face.flavorText: 我觉得还挺苗条的。

face.name: Bloatray
face.flavorText: Looks pretty svelte to me.

face.name: 强能箭猪
face.text: 亡语： 造成等同于本随从攻击力的伤害，随机分配到所有敌人身上。
face.flavorText: 上吧，爆壳猛猪，扎透他们！

face.name: Augmented Porcupine
face.text: Deathrattle: Deal this minion's Attack damage randomly split among all enemies.
face.flavorText: Pokey-man. Gotta spike 'em all!

face.name: 荆棘谷猛虎
face.flavorText: 这些美丽的大猫是荆棘谷一道亮丽的风景！

face.name: Stranglethorn Tiger
face.flavorText: The wonderful thing about tigers is tigers are wonderful things!

face.name: 沼泽水蛭
face.flavorText: 除去四颗牙，都是高蛋白。

face.name: Swamp Leech
face.flavorText: A face only a druid could love.

face.name: 铁鬃灰熊
face.flavorText: “瘦死的棕熊比兽人大。”

face.name: Ironfur Grizzly
face.flavorText: "Bear Carcass 1/10"

face.name: 银背族长
face.flavorText: 尽管他表现得像个领导者，但实际上银背母猩猩才是真正管事的人。

face.name: Silverback Patriarch
face.flavorText: He likes to act like he's in charge, but the silverback matriarch actually runs things.

face.name: 幼龙鹰
face.flavorText: 无论是战士还是诗人，都能从美丽的龙鹰身上获取战斗或是写作的灵感。

face.name: Young Dragonhawk
face.flavorText: They were the inspiration for the championship Taurenball team: The Dragonhawks.

face.name: 邪巢诱捕蛛
face.flavorText: 它本有志成为邪巢舞者的，无奈八条腿总踩到别人脚。

face.name: Vilebrood Skitterer
face.flavorText: It aspires to be a Vilebrood Dancer, but it has eight left feet.

face.name: 血虫
face.flavorText: 兰娜瑟尔女王每天早餐都要吃上一条，必须炸得嘎嘣脆。

face.name: Bloodworm
face.flavorText: Queen Lana'thel insists on one of these, fried, every morning for breakfast.

face.name: 翡翠天爪枭
face.flavorText: 这些勇猛的天爪枭曾在翡翠巨龙圣地宣誓保卫伊瑟拉，被翡翠梦境的力量所触及，呈现出了晶莹剔透的外观。

face.name: Emerald Skytalon
face.flavorText: Sworn protectors of Ysera at the Emerald Dragonshrine, these majestic owls have been touched by the powers of the Emerald Dream, taking on an almost crystalline appearance.

face.name: 厄运鼹鼠
face.flavorText: 你肯定不想让厄运鼹鼠把洞穴挖的满山都是吧。

face.name: Dire Mole
face.flavorText: You especially don't want to make a dire mountain out of a dire mole hill.

face.name: 错误产物
face.flavorText: 一个美丽的意外。

face.name: Mistake
face.flavorText: We like to think of it as a happy accident.

face.name: 流沙巨口
face.flavorText: 最爱的风味：香草。

face.name: Sandmaw
face.flavorText: Its favorite flavor: vanilla.

face.name: 剑龙
face.flavorText: 升到40级的圣骑士被要求去驯服一头剑龙，所以这世界上并不存在41级的圣骑士。

face.name: Stegodon
face.flavorText: Level 40 Tortollan Paladins quest to tame a Stegodon. There are no level 41 Tortollan Paladins.
